li.name: workLamps
li.label: work lamps
li.description: Floodlights that light the ground round the vehicle while it stands still at night, so work nearby goes on at the pace of daylight. They run off the battery when the engine is off.
li.autoDescription: they light by themselves in the dark while the vehicle stands still with your people near it, and go out an hour after the last one leaves. With the engine off and no power cable, they light only while the battery is more than half full, so it can still start the engine
li.standbyLabel: waiting for dark and a stop
li.autoStandbyLabel: waiting for dark, a stop and people near

li.name: headlights
li.label: headlights
li.description: Switched on, the headlights light the ground ahead of the vehicle at night. With the engine off they run the battery down.
li.autoDescription: they light by themselves in the dark while the vehicle is driven or its engine runs, and go out once it is parked with the engine off
li.autoStandbyLabel: waiting for dark and a driver

li.name: cabHeater
li.label: cab heater
li.description: The cab heater runs below 5 °C while the engine runs, on the engine's own heat: it warms the cab only once the engine has warmed up, and not at all with the coolant gone.

li.name: instruments
li.label: engine electronics and instruments
li.description: The engine's control unit, injectors, fuel pump and ignition, with the instruments: always on while the engine runs.

li.name: climateControl
li.label: climate control
li.description: Holds the cab near 21 °C by itself while the engine runs, heating or cooling as needed. Switch it off to use the heater and air conditioner by hand.

li.name: airConditioner
li.label: air conditioner
li.description: The air conditioner cools the cab above 26 °C while the engine runs.

li.name: nightHeater
li.label: night heater
li.description: A fuel-burning heater that keeps the cab and the engine warm while the caravan camps for the night with the engine off, so it starts easily in the morning, and while someone sleeps in the cab bunk of a parked vehicle or warms up in its cab. Switch it on before you leave; it needs the night heater setting.

li.name: turretDrive
li.label: turret drive
li.description: The motors that turn the turret and lay the gun, drawing while someone mans a powered weapon. Without power the crew cranks it round by hand, slowly.

li.name: winch
li.label: recovery winch
li.description: The recovery winch's motor, drawing while it pulls. A long pull on a flat battery stops it: run the engine while winching.
